responsibility: This header defines GCC's generic typed streaming API used by LTO and other serialized compiler data. It declares the bitpack_d state object, inline helpers for packing and unpacking fixed-width fields, ranges, enums, and polynomial values, record-start helpers, byte-at-a-time stream access, and the public read/write routines implemented in the data-streamer source files. It is the central interface between compiler subsystems and the low-level LTO byte stream format for basic scalar and string data.
same_name_distinction: Defines the generic streamer and bitpack interface used across LTO, including bitpack_d, many inline pack/unpack helpers, and declarations spanning data-streamer.cc plus the separate in/out streamer files. The .cc file only implements the primitive variable-length integer codecs.
